My account holds $75,000 in cash plus 50 BA shares, so a modest purchase was well funded without needing to liquidate anything (consistent with the rule to never move money out of the account). I confirmed the reported fundamentals via SEC filings: FY2024 (10-K filed 2024-10-09) revenue of $254,453M, net income of $7,367M, and diluted EPS of $16.56 — a steady, profitable business, and at ~$891 the stock trades at roughly 54x trailing EPS, which is rich but typical for COST's premium multiple. With no adverse news and a healthy cash balance, I placed a single buy order for 5 shares with a limit of $892.00, just 0.1% above the ask so it stayed "close to the current market" while ensuring execution; it filled at $892.00 for about $4,460 — within both the $5,000 per-order cap and the $10,000 daily cap, leaving room for a BA order if warranted. The key figures my decision relied on were FY2024 revenue of $254,453M, net income of $7,367M, and diluted EPS of $16.56.
